## `mpx init`

Initialize an MPX project.

- `mpx init` — default operation

## `mpx status`

Show current project status.

- `mpx status` — default operation

## `mpx doctor`

Diagnose project configuration and services.

- `mpx doctor` — default operation

## `mpx launch`

Explain or start a runtime launch.

### `mpx launch explain [options]`

Explain launch selection.

Examples:

- `mpx launch explain --identity work`

### `mpx launch claude [options]`

Launch Claude.

### `mpx launch pi [options]`

Launch Pi.

### `mpx launch current`

Show the process-bound launch.

### `mpx launch sbx-plan-export [options]`

Export a sandbox launch plan.

### `mpx cc [options]`

Launch Claude using the short alias.

### `mpx ccw [options]`

Launch Claude in the work preset.

### `mpx piw [options]`

Launch Pi in the work preset.

## `mpx session`

Inspect and manage runtime sessions.

### `mpx session list [options]`

List sessions.

### `mpx session show <id>`

Show one session.

### `mpx session resume <id> [options]`

Resume one session.

Examples:

- `mpx session resume abc123`

### `mpx session save <id...> | --all-active`

Capture active sessions.

### `mpx session branch <parent-id> [options]`

Create a child session.

### `mpx session mark <id> <status> [options]`

Set workflow status.

### `mpx session handoff <id> [options]`

Record a session handoff.

### `mpx session complete <id> [options]`

Complete a session.

### `mpx session inbox [options]`

List session inbox entries.

### `mpx session reconcile [options]`

Reconcile discovered sessions.

### `mpx session completion <id> [options]`

Complete a session (compatibility alias).

### `mpx session resurrect-export`

Export resurrection data.

## `mpx issue`

Work with provider-neutral issues.

### `mpx issue list [--state open|finished]`

List issues.

### `mpx issue view --id <id>`

View an issue.

Examples:

- `mpx issue view --id 123`

### `mpx issue create --title <title> --body <body>`

Create an issue.

### `mpx issue edit --id <id> --title <title> --body <body>`

Edit an issue.

### `mpx issue comment --id <id> --body <body>`

Comment on an issue.

### `mpx issue label --id <id> --label <label>`

Label an issue.

### `mpx issue move --id <id> --destination <target>`

Move an issue.

### `mpx issue finish --id <id>`

Finish an issue.

### `mpx issue dependency <add|remove> --id <id> --dependency-id <id>`

Add or remove a dependency.

### `mpx issue show --id <id>`

View an issue (alias).

### `mpx issue update --id <id> --title <title> --body <body>`

Edit an issue (alias).

### `mpx issue close --id <id>`

Finish an issue (alias).
